basic_details.job_title: IMSc Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 14 Project Technical Assistant, Project Scientific Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Contract project positions under the Apex Projects of The Institute of Mathematical Sciences (IMSc), Chennai, an autonomous institution under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India, are open under Advt No. 07-R/IMSc/2026 dated 24 November 2026: 17 posts, from Project Technical Assistant (Library) to Project Scientific Officer "C" and Project Assistant (Admin), initially for one year with no scope of regularization, on a consolidated all-inclusive salary between Rs. 32,500/- and Rs. 95,000/- p.m. depending on the post. Each post has its own qualification, experience and age limit.

For Sl. No. 10 to 17, download the application format for the relevant post, fill it and sign it.
Scan the signed application and attach self-attested copies of the relevant certificates.

Submit or email the application before 1800 hrs on 9 December 2026.
Applications or emails sent after the deadline will not be considered under any circumstances, and hard copies of applications or resumes sent by hand, post or courier will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: About IMSc
content_sections.text: The Institute of Mathematical Sciences (IMSc), Chennai describes itself as a National Institute of higher learning which fosters high quality fundamental research in frontier disciplines of Mathematical Sciences, with an intensive teaching programme for the award of M.Sc (by Research) and Ph.D. Degree. It is located at 4th Cross Road, CIT Campus, Taramani, Chennai 600 113. These positions are under the Institute's Apex Projects, which include sub-projects on library information resource management, IT and media infrastructure, health and disease, quantum materials, science communication and computational biology.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 17 project positions. The positions printed for Sl. No. 1 to 12 add up to 14. The number of positions for Sl. No. 13 to 17 and the salary for Sl. No. 15 could not be read in the copy of the notice used for this article; check them in the official notification PDF. Age limits are counted as on the last date of submission of application. For Project Scientific Assistant – Systems and Networks (Level-1), the upper age limit is relaxable in the case of exceptionally qualified, highly experienced, or deserving candidates at the discretion of the Competent Authority.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential experience: Minimum 2 years experience in academic / research / special libraries in handling acquisition, circulation, journal subscriptions and technical processing (cataloging and classification etc), working knowledge of basic computer applications. Working knowledge and experience in managing the institutional repository software (DSpace/e-prints) and Koha ILS in Linux environment, handling research publications, citation databases and reporting. Experience in organizing, cataloguing, describing, digitizing and preserving physical and digital archival materials, including photographs, reports, theses and institutional records. Knowledge of HTML, SQL, Archival standards, Metadata standards, cataloguing (RDA, AACR II) and classification standards. Desirable qualification: UGC-NET in Library and Information Science, or an equivalent accredited test such as SLET/SET; Post graduate diploma in library automation and networking (PGDLAN). Desirable: training experience from a reputed University/ research Institute; experience in compiling annual reports or other technical reports using LaTeX. Essential: minimum two years of experience in software development projects. Proficiency in software development on Linux/Unix operating systems using Python, PHP, and MySQL/MariaDB. Working knowledge of frontend web technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript) and version control tools (Git). Desirable: formal I.T. coursework or certifications covering HTML/PHP, Python, MySQL, and LaTeX; exposure to web frameworks (e.g., Django, Flask, or Laravel) or CMS platforms; prior work experience in an academic, research, or scientific organization. Essential experience: minimum 15 years of experience in the following: Linux System and Server Administration Database Management Type 1 and Type 2 Hypervisors Management Email Server Administration Enterprise Routing and Switching IT Security including NGFW, WAF Web applications and Content Management Linux/Unix, Shell, PHP Scripting techniques Videoconference Administration and Management IT Asset Management and IT Service Management High-Performance Computing Cluster Management Desirable qualification for PSO-C and for all three Systems and Networks levels: Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) or Linux Professional Institute Certification (LPIC); Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) or equivalent networking credentials; Proxmox / VMware virtualization or cloud administration certifications. Essential experience: minimum 15 years for Level-1 and minimum 5 years for Level - 2, in the following: Linux System and Server Administration and Database Management Web applications and Content Management Linux/Unix, Shell, PHP Scripting techniques Deep understanding of dynamic routing protocols (OSPF, BGP) and Layer 2/3 operations (VLANs, trunking, spanning-tree protocols) Hands-on configuration and troubleshooting experience with enterprise hardware platforms (e.g., Cisco Catalyst, Aruba switches) Expert deployment of IPsec

rows.essential_qualification: Masters in Library and Information science (MLIS / MLISc / Mlib.Sc / M.Sc Library and Information Science) with first class.

Bachelors Degree in Engineering (Computer Science/ ECE/ EEE/M.Sc / M.Tech (computer science) / Computer Applications / Engineering (Computer Science / ECE / EEE/ IT) from a reputed recognised College/ University.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The salary for every post is a consolidated amount per month, which the notice describes as "all inclusive & no other allowances are allowed". The positions are proposed to be filled purely on contract basis, initially for a period of one year from the date of appointment, and the notice states there is no scope of regularization / absorption under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: IMSc Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Annual Report System: design, develop, and deploy a new annual report management system using Python, MySQL/MariaDB, and LaTeX on a Linux environment. Library & Archives Systems: assist in the design, development, feature enhancement, and maintenance of institutional library management and digital archive platforms. Upkeep of buildings of the Institute, wash rooms, common places Maintaining the Registers Supervising duties of house keeping cleaners Allotment of office rooms, Guest house rooms & hostel rooms, etc. Upkeep of buildings of the Institute, wash rooms, common places High standards of customer care and performance Maintaining the Registers and supervising duties of House Keeping Cleaners Allotment of office rooms, Guest house rooms & hostel rooms, etc. Menu Planning Food costing and budgeting Canteen and refreshment / Coffee Pantry management Maintaining Billing registers and Expenditure statements

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IMSc Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: For Sl. No. 1 to 9, apply through the online link https://www.imsc.res.in/other_positions given in the notice. For Sl. No. 10 to 17, download the application format for the relevant post, fill it and sign it. Scan the signed application and attach self-attested copies of the relevant certificates. Email them to the unique email ID given against the post (listed in the vacancy table). Write the subject as: "Application for the Project Position (Name of the Project Position in Capital Letters) of Advt.07-R/IMSc/2026 dt. 24.11.2026". The notice calls this subject line very important. Submit or email the application before 1800 hrs on 9 December 2026. Applications or emails sent after the deadline will not be considered under any circumstances, and hard copies of applications or resumes sent by hand, post or courier will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are screened against the minimum qualifications and experience, and the screened list is displayed on the "Opportunities page" of www.imsc.res.in . Only shortlisted candidates whose names are displayed need to appear. The method differs by post: The date of the written test / interview for every post will be announced later. Candidates should produce one copy of a valid ID proof with the original (such as Aadhaar, Driving License, Passport or Voter ID).

rows.selection_method: Merit through a written test; only those who qualify are called for interview (proposed for afternoon).
Merit through a written test and skill test; only those who qualify in both are called for interview (proposed for afternoon).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IMSc Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The IMSc notice lists 17 project positions; Sl. No. 1 to 12 carry 14 positions, including 03 for Project Technical Assistant (Library).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IMSc Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online or emailed before 1800 hrs on 9 December 2026; late applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IMSc project positions?
faq.answer: It varies by post, from a Diploma in Electrical, Civil, Film Editing or Hotel Management to B.E./B.Tech, M.Sc. IT, MCA or a Masters in Library and Information Science, mostly with set years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IMSc Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit varies by post from 25 years to 50 years as on the last date of submission of application; for example, 40 years for Project Technical Assistant (Library) and 50 years for PSO-C.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for IMSc project positions?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary ranges from Rs. 32,500/- p.m. (Media & Communication Level 3) to Rs. 95,000/- p.m. (Project Scientific Officer "C"), all inclusive with no other allowances.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for IMSc Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Sl. No. 1 to 9 apply through the online link https://www.imsc.res.in/other_positions; Sl. No. 10 to 17 email the signed application format with self-attested certificates to the email ID given for the post.

faq.question: Q7. What should I write in the email subject?
faq.answer: Write "Application for the Project Position (Name of the Project Position in Capital Letters) of Advt.07-R/IMSc/2026 dt. 24.11.2026".

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IMSc project positions?
faq.answer: Depending on the post, selection is by direct interview of shortlisted candidates, or a written test (and skill test for Sl. No. 2) followed by interview; dates will be announced later.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IMSc project position permanent?
faq.answer: No. The positions are purely on contract basis, initially for one year from the date of appointment, with no scope of regularization / absorption under any circumstances.

faq.question: Q10. Can I send a hard copy of the application to IMSc?
faq.answer: No. Hard copies of applications or resumes received by hand, post or courier will not be considered under any circumstances.
